measurement: Published SCB May val-idag estimate to September election; survey error plus campaign change.
closure: Each poll and election is closed to that panel's named parties; denominators differ across panels. OTHER and missing SD are never imputed.
historical_isotropic: Zero-mean isotropic CLR Gaussian; sigma^2=sum of squared training CLR residuals/(n*(p-1)).
historical_bias_shrunk_covariance: Training mean CLR error plus 50% sample covariance and 50% isotropic covariance in the CLR zero-sum subspace. Fixed shrinkage, not selected on test.
metrics: RMSE and MAE of ensemble-mean composition in percentage points
all-party joint coverage of those marginal intervals
selection: All declared models reported. No best model selected, no production profile changed, no post-test tuning.
vintage: Only original-release numbers transcribed from SCB publications/official SCB press accounts are admitted. The current Vid10 series retrospectively reweights 2010–2019 and is excluded.
zero_handling: Reject nonpositive or missing shares in a selected panel; do not add a pseudocount or invent a new-party history.
scope: Retrospective rolling-origin national-composition experiment; no full district election replay for newly added years, no prospective blind-validation or government-probability claim. Later outcomes in earlier training labels are necessary historical training data; target outcomes are used only for scoring.
